messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

AI data center connectivity is shifting toward higher-speed electrical interconnects, including OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 and aggregate 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T per cable assembly [6].
AI data center connectivity also includes XtremePass 448G connector solutions across Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe, and InfiniBand systems [6].
AI data center optical connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for AI scale-up deployments and 200G/lane optical modules supporting 1.6T OSFP transceiver configurations [2].
AI server PCB sources say AI server trends push PCBs toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission [26].
AI server PCB sources also say materials are moving toward HVLP copper foil generations 4 and 5, M8 CCL, low-Dk, low-loss, and high-thermal designs [26].
R&S PCB test flows measure impedance by TDR, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and eye diagrams [18].
The same R&S PCB test flow includes signal-integrity modeling/testing and sampling testing for insertion loss, Dk/Df, roughness, and impedance [18].
For Signaling Tester capability, the R&S CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [32].
For Wi-Fi 7 signaling, the CMX500 test context includes signaling mode, real-world RF TX/RX characteristics, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [58].
For Wi-Fi 8 signaling, the CMX500 context adds Wi-Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn RF signaling tests, dRU measurements, UEQM analysis, MLO, up to 7.125 GHz supported frequencies, up to 320 MHz channel bandwidths, and 4096QAM [64].
For Non-signaling Tester capability, the R&S CMP180 is described as a production-phase non-signaling RF measurement tester supporting Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [58].
The CMP180 source also says two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports are integrated for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 units can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access points [58].
【推論】AI data center high-speed electrical, optical, and PCB changes mainly increase the need for SI / PCB measurements such as TDR impedance, Dk/Df, insertion loss, crosstalk, and eye diagram, rather than proving a direct new requirement for cellular/WLAN signaling testers.[2][6][18][26]
【推論】If the Signaling Tester is used for WLAN/cellular functions associated with data-center equipment, the relevant capability direction is multi-technology signaling, Wi-Fi 7/8, MLO, multiple RF chains, MIMO, 6 GHz / 7.125 GHz operation, 320 MHz channels, and throughput/PER/BLER-type measurements.[32][58][64]
【推論】If the Non-signaling Tester is used for production RF checks, the relevant capability direction is up to 8 GHz coverage, up to 500 MHz bandwidth, multi-port analyzer/generator resources, and 2x2 to 4x4 MIMO scalability.[58]

- [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]] — 來源稱其為 12-channel duplex optical transceiver，up to 25Gbps per channel，300Gbps cumulative on multi-mode fiber。
- [[300G CXP2 Active Optical Cable]] — 來源稱 CXP2 to CXP2 AOC provides cost-effective plug and play cabling solution，delivers high hardware faceplate port density among existing SFF industry standards。
- [[CommScope Rapid Fiber Connect Platform]] — 來源稱其 simplifies and accelerates AI scaling by pre-integrating optics off-site and reducing on-site fiber connections。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Power 與 cooling connectivity

R&S PCB test solutions
[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

AI data center connectivity is shifting toward higher-speed electrical interconnects, including OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 and aggregate 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T per cable assembly [6].
AI data center connectivity also includes XtremePass 448G connector solutions across Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe, and InfiniBand systems [6].
AI data center optical connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for AI scale-up deployments and 200G/lane optical modules supporting 1.6T OSFP transceiver configurations [2].
AI server PCB sources say AI server trends push PCBs toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission [26].
AI server PCB sources also say materials are moving toward HVLP copper foil generations 4 and 5, M8 CCL, low-Dk, low-loss, and high-thermal designs [26].
R&S PCB test flows measure impedance by TDR, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and eye diagrams [18].
The same R&S PCB test flow includes signal-integrity modeling/testing and sampling testing for insertion loss, Dk/Df, roughness, and impedance [18].
For Signaling Tester capability, the R&S CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [32].
For Wi-Fi 7 signaling, the CMX500 test context includes signaling mode, real-world RF TX/RX characteristics, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [58].
For Wi-Fi 8 signaling, the CMX500 context adds Wi-Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn RF signaling tests, dRU measurements, UEQM analysis, MLO, up to 7.125 GHz supported frequencies, up to 320 MHz channel bandwidths, and 4096QAM [64].
For Non-signaling Tester capability, the R&S CMP180 is described as a production-phase non-signaling RF measurement tester supporting Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [58].
The CMP180 source also says two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports are integrated for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 units can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access points [58].
【推論】AI data center high-speed electrical, optical, and PCB changes mainly increase the need for SI / PCB measurements such as TDR impedance, Dk/Df, insertion loss, crosstalk, and eye diagram, rather than proving a direct new requirement for cellular/WLAN signaling testers.[2][6][18][26]
【推論】If the Signaling Tester is used for WLAN/cellular functions associated with data-center equipment, the relevant capability direction is multi-technology signaling, Wi-Fi 7/8, MLO, multiple RF chains, MIMO, 6 GHz / 7.125 GHz operation, 320 MHz channels, and throughput/PER/BLER-type measurements.[32][58][64]
【推論】If the Non-signaling Tester is used for production RF checks, the relevant capability direction is up to 8 GHz coverage, up to 500 MHz bandwidth, multi-port analyzer/generator resources, and 2x2 to 4x4 MIMO scalability.[58]

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。
